skill.name: agentdb-reinforcement-learning-training
skill.description: Guide RL agent training with AgentDB using environment setup, algorithm selection, TypeScript training loops, benchmarking, and deployment patterns.
skill.summary: Build, train, validate, and deploy AgentDB reinforcement learning agents with guided TypeScript workflows.
skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code fences and TypeScript template literals. The confirmed findings are documented bash and npm commands in SKILL.md that could install packages or run local Node scripts if executed automatically. No prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Pin package versions, avoid @latest, and require human confirmation before any package installation step.

remediation.issue: Executable shell training script in documentation
remediation.suggestion: Label the script as manual-only, split it into reviewed steps, and avoid automatic execution by agents.

remediation.issue: Production API example lacks deployment security guidance
remediation.suggestion: Add input validation, authentication, rate limiting, and monitoring requirements before production deployment.

content.value_statement: RL agent training is difficult to organize across setup, algorithms, metrics, and deployment. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a structured AgentDB workflow for training and validating agents.
actual_capabilities: Guides setup of an AgentDB learning database, plugin, environment, and monitor.
Covers Q-Learning, SARSA, DQN, Actor-Critic, PPO, A2C, TD3, SAC, and Decision Transformer.
Provides TypeScript training loop patterns with replay buffers, checkpoints, evaluation, and convergence checks.
Describes benchmarking against a random baseline using reward, success rate, and inference timing.
Outlines deployment with model export, an Express inference API, monitoring, and staged pipeline steps.
limitations: It provides workflow guidance and examples, not a complete runnable project.
It assumes AgentDB packages, APIs, and a TypeScript environment are available.
Users must review npm and shell commands before running them.
It does not validate model safety, fairness, or full production security.

use_cases.title: Prototype a Learning Agent
use_cases.description: Plan an AgentDB reinforcement learning experiment with environment setup, algorithm choice, and training metrics.

use_cases.title: Benchmark RL Algorithms
use_cases.description: Compare DQN, PPO, SAC, and baseline policies using reward, success rate, and inference timing.

use_cases.title: Prepare Agent Deployment
use_cases.description: Define export, API, monitoring, and pipeline steps for moving a trained agent toward production.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a First Training Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a first AgentDB DQN training run. Include environment setup, algorithm choice, metrics, and safety checks.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Experience Replay
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to configure experience replay for my AgentDB agent. Recommend hyperparameters and explain validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Compare RL Algorithms
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to compare DQN, PPO, SAC, and Actor-Critic for my task. Rank options by data needs, stability, and deployment cost.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design an AgentDB RL deployment pipeline. Include checkpoints, benchmark gates, monitoring, rollback, and manual command review.

output_examples.input: I need to train a grid-world agent with AgentDB.
output_examples.output: A five-phase plan covering setup, DQN configuration, training loops, evaluation episodes, and deployment readiness checks.

output_examples.input: We need to choose between DQN, PPO, and SAC for a new task.
output_examples.output: A practical comparison of each algorithm by action space, stability, sample needs, tuning effort, and production cost.

output_examples.input: Our trained agent is ready for validation.
output_examples.output: A benchmark checklist with baseline comparison, reward targets, success rate thresholds, inference timing, and monitoring requirements.

best_practices: Start with a simple environment and baseline before tuning complex algorithms.
Track reward, loss, exploration rate, success rate, and inference timing together.
Pin dependencies and review every command before running training scripts.
anti_patterns: Do not deploy an agent because reward improved without baseline comparison.
Do not run npm or shell commands from the skill without review.
Do not tune many hyperparameters before confirming the environment and rewards are correct.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps plan and implement AgentDB reinforcement learning workflows for training, validation, and deployment.

faq.question: Which algorithms are covered?
faq.answer: It covers Q-Learning, SARSA, DQN, Actor-Critic, PPO, A2C, TD3, SAC, and Decision Transformer.

faq.question: Does it create a complete application?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance and example patterns that users adapt to their project.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Are there commands to review?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes npm and shell examples that should require human confirmation before execution.

faq.question: What should I validate before deployment?
faq.answer: Validate reward convergence, baseline improvement, success rate, inference latency, monitoring, and API security controls.
